mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS favoriteId, f.created_at AS favoritedAt, b.id, b.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, b.title, b.author, b.isbn, b.price, b.stock, b.status, b.cover_url AS coverUrl, b.description FROM book_favorite f INNER JOIN book b ON b.id = f.book_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = b.category_id WHERE f.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
